## Problem / user value

What outcome should change, and for whom?

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Main expected behavior
- [ ] At least one failure or authorization scenario
- [ ] API or data changes are identified, if applicable

## Verification

Commands and tests that will prove this works (fill before implementation).

## Scope boundary

Explicitly list what this issue will not do.

## Design notes

Reference a relevant ADR, requirement (FR-xx / NFR-xx), or API contract.
